name: Overtime and holiday work above 36 hours a week

rules.when: !(has(terms.facts.continuous_work) && terms.facts.continuous_work == true) && work.days.exists(d, sum((work.days + (has(work.week_before) ? work.week_before : [])).filter(e, int(calendar_distance_days("2024-01-01", e.date)) / 7 == int(calendar_distance_days("2024-01-01", d.date)) / 7).map(e, e.overtime_hours + ((e.holiday_kind != "" || e.day_type == "REST") ? max(e.worked_hours - e.overtime_hours, 0.0) : 0.0))) > 36.0)
rules.message: Overtime plus holiday work exceeds 36 hours in a week (LPA s.26 with Ministerial Regulation No. 3): the hours are paid, but the employer may not require them.
rules.description: Verified 2026-10-10 in Department of Labour Protection and Welfare, February 2014 English compilation, printed page 64 (PDF page 64), Ministerial Regulation No. 3 B.E. 2541, signed 19 August 1998; Gazette vol.115 Part49 Kor p.12. Public mirror: https://www.fischerandpartners.com/mt-content/uploads/2019/01/tha49727-eng.pdf. It covers section 24 paragraph 1 overtime and section 25 paragraphs 2-3 holiday work, including holiday overtime; section 24 paragraph 2 and section 25 paragraph 1 necessary continuous/emergency work are outside this aggregate. The declared contract fact continuous_work identifies those exceptions. A Monday-Sunday week includes recorded days before the pay period (work.week_before); holiday/rest normal hours plus overtime count once, without capping actual holiday work at eight hours.

rules.message: A deduction exceeds the LPA s.76 limits — 10% of the wages due for the loan or the provident fund contribution, one fifth for both together — without the employee's recorded prior consent: the slip is held.
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.76 para 2: deductions under (2)-(5) (union dues, cooperative or welfare debts, a guarantee or damages, provident fund contributions) each at most 10% and together one fifth of the money due to the employee at the s.70 payment time — wages, overtime, holiday pay and holiday overtime (the work and fixed-allowance lines of the slip, not a bonus or other one-off pay) — except with the employee's consent. Council of State consolidated text https://searchlaw.ocs.go.th/council-of-state/#/public/doc/ZGN3NXk0eENvNjBSdjRnT2NsdjFTQT09, read 2026-10-08. rules.when: work.days.exists(d, d.scheduled_hours > (has(terms.facts.normal_hours_per_day) ? double(terms.facts.normal_hours_per_day) : (terms.work_classification == "HAZARDOUS" ? 7.0 : 8.0))) || work.days.exists(d, sum(work.days.filter(e, int(calendar_distance_days("2024-01-01", e.date)) / 7 == int(calendar_distance_days("2024-01-01", d.date)) / 7).map(e, e.scheduled_hours)) > (has(terms.facts.normal_hours_per_day) ? double(terms.facts.normal_hours_per_day) : (terms.work_classification == "HAZARDOUS" ? 7.0 : 8.0)) * 6.0)
rules.message: Normal working time exceeds 8 hours a day or 48 a week (7 and 42 for hazardous work) (LPA s.23).
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.23 and Ministerial Regulation No. 2: normal time at most 8 hours a day and 48 a week; for work harmful to health 7 and 42. Weekly limit read as 6 × the daily limit over a Monday-Sunday week of planned hours. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

rules.when: work.days.exists(d, d.worked_hours > 5.0 && size(d.intervals) == 1)
rules.message: A day of more than five consecutive working hours was recorded without a rest break (LPA s.27).
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.27: a rest period of at least one hour after no more than five consecutive working hours (or shorter breaks totalling an hour by agreement); 20 minutes before overtime of two hours or more. More than five paid hours in one unbroken interval show no break: a recorded clock pair on a shift with a planned break is netted around it into two intervals, and the ordinary and overtime spans of one block stay one interval. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

rules.when: work.days.exists(d, size(work.days.filter(e, e.date >= d.date && e.date <= add_days(d.date, 6) && e.worked)) >= 7)
rules.message: Seven consecutive days were worked without a weekly holiday (LPA s.28).
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.28: at least one weekly holiday a week, no more than six days apart; in hotel, transport, forest or remote work it may be accumulated within four weeks by prior agreement. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

rules.message: Overtime or holiday work was paid without the employee's recorded prior consent (LPA ss.24-25).
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.24: overtime only with the employee's prior consent each time, except continuous or emergency work; s.25: holiday work likewise, beyond the listed undertakings. Consent is per day (owner ruling): a day with paid overtime, or a published holiday worked, without that day's recorded consent (work.days[].overtime_consented, from the work-day sheet) warns; contract fact continuous_work exempts. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

rules.message: A pregnant employee worked overtime, on a holiday or between 22:00 and 06:00 (LPA s.39).
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.39: no work 22:00-06:00, overtime or holiday work for a pregnant employee (s.39/1 allows executive, academic, clerical or financial work with her consent); s.43: no dismissal for pregnancy. Customer input: employee fact pregnant. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

rules.message: An employee under 18 worked overtime, on a holiday or between 22:00 and 06:00 (LPA ss.47-48).
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.47: no work 22:00-06:00 for a child under 18 without the Director-General's permission; s.48: no overtime or holiday work. Wages are paid to the child (s.51); the paid training leave of s.52 is the YOUNG_WORKER_TRAINING_LEAVE class. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

rules.message: An employee under 15 may not be employed (LPA s.44).
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.44: no employer shall employ a child under 15. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).
